items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: >> [SPEAKER_04] Fess has the one that George Barquet once bought for Alfred Wilson. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] Way back.

ctx.x: I didn't need it in there across here. I had a cross there. I had a big heart here. And I had all inside this band line. Heart on the bell. Oh, yeah. When I played like that man, he was just like you. And really ran me down for that. But he didn't get that neither. I sold that and then I sold a pencil model to a front of mine. He gave me a hundred dollars for that pencil model. Fess wanted it too. Fess got a buffet, a buffet.
Fess has the one that George Barquet once bought for Alfred Wilson. Yeah.
